baseline_findings.finding: Flux numerator remained 10 after q was reduced to 3.
baseline_findings.resolution: Central parameter normalization now enforces 1 ≤ p < q.

baseline_findings.finding: A zero Bravais angle denominator reached Pyodide and exposed a ZeroDivisionError traceback.
baseline_findings.resolution: Angle and scalar bounds are normalized before URL writing or computation.

baseline_findings.finding: The lattice view labeled a reciprocal primitive parallelogram as the first Brillouin zone and drew q·a₂ outside the SVG panel.
baseline_findings.evidence: triangular q=11 used four reciprocal edges; square magnetic path reached y=-538 outside viewBox
baseline_findings.resolution: The adapter now constructs the reciprocal Wigner–Seitz cell and the UI uses a bounded magnetic-cell inset with equal spatial scale.

baseline_findings.finding: Individual Berry/Chern values were shown for touching Kagome and honeycomb bands.
baseline_findings.evidence: Kagome individual Chern sums varied with momentum sampling.
baseline_findings.resolution: Touching bands are grouped with the non-Abelian projector formulation already present upstream; grouped Chern values are stable and the complete bundle sums to zero.

baseline_findings.finding: Cancelled computations could later overwrite “Computation cancelled” with a completion state.
baseline_findings.resolution: ComputeEngine now throws a cancellation terminal and clears worker cancellation bookkeeping.
